Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/plain","uri":"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"chunking":{"chunker_type":"text","max_chars":300,"max_overlap":40,"trim":true}}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].chunks);
}
```
